data.title: Building Shapes with Unit Squares
data.description: Practice constructing different geometric shapes on a square grid by counting unit squares to match a given target area.

challenges.narration: Each square on the grid is one square unit.
challenges.instruction: Make a shape with an area of 5 squares.
challenges.hint: Count each square as you shade it. Every square in your shape must touch another one along a side.

challenges.narration: Each square on the grid is one square unit.

challenges.hint: Count each square as you shade it. Every square in your shape must touch another one along a side.

challenges.narration: Each square on the grid is one square unit.
challenges.instruction: Make a shape with an area of 11 squares. Then make a different shape with the same area.
challenges.hint: Count each square as you shade it. Every square in your shape must touch another one along a side.
